licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by one reader, then checked bar by bar by a separate fresh checker; every bar of every part adds up. The English singing translation and the stage directions are left out. Secco recitative: the keyboard is written as the piano. Playback tempo: free, as recitative is sung; played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 99, from the median length of 3 recordings (Fricsay 1:07, Böhm 1:07, Karajan 1:11).
